newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FORESBANK POSTS JAN-SEPT CZK 71.1 MLN GROSS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FORESBANK POSTS JAN-SEPT CZK 71.1 MLN GROSS.

text.p: Czech bank Foresbank a.s. said on Friday its gross profit for the first nine months of this year reached 71.1 million crowns, compared with 68.8 million for the whole of 1995.
The bank said in a statement that its total assets rose to 16.7 billion from 7.7 billion at the beginning of the year, while total clients' deposits increased to 11.5 billion from 3.6 billion.
Total loans granted, at the end of September, stood at 6.1 billion, up from 2.6 billion at the end of last year.
The statement added that classified and doubtfull credits were 4.24 percent of the bank's total loan prtfolio.
Comparative resluts for the first nine months of 1995 were not available.
Foresbank is a small, closely-held institution based in the eastern town of Zlin.
